frozen_relation.statement: The PSI result retains its null central status, positive 1.1 and 0.2 times ten-to-the-minus-26 uncertainty magnitudes and positive 1.8 times ten-to-the-minus-26 90-percent upper bound. The six proton modes retain 90-percent partial-lifetime lower limits 2.4e34, 1.6e34, 1.4e34, 7.3e33, 7.2e33 and 4.5e33 years. No source reports a statistically significant proton-decay signal; the explicitly retained candidates are background compatible. Thus no registered row violates the sealed aligned-One or fibre-preserving baryon-One predictions.
